newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Packaging reports Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Packaging reports Q2 loss.

text.p: Integrated Packaging Assembly Corp Tuesday reported a loss of $6,088,000 or $0.44 per share for the second quarter of 1997, compared with net income of $567,000 or $0.04 per share, for the second quarter of 1996.
The company said the loss for the latest quarter included a charge of $3.0 million, principally for the write down of impaired assets.
Revenues for the second quarter ended June 30, 1997 were $3,953,000 compared with revenues of $8,469,000 for the same period a year ago.

For the first six months of 1997, IPAC reported revenues of $9,528,000 compared to revenues of $16,526,000 for the first six months of 1996. The company reported a net loss of $8,561,000 or $0.62 per share, in the first six months of 1997 compared with net income of $1,179,000 or $0.09 per share for the same period a year ago.

"As previously indicated, our revenues and operating results continue to be adversely impacted by our dependence on a limited customer base and reduced order levels from certain of these customers," said Patrick Verderico, president and chief executive officer. "We believe the restructuring and reorganization program we implemented in mid-June, as well as more focused sales and marketing efforts, will position us to enhance our operating efficiency, broaden IPAC's customer base and return the company to profitability."
